s1.title: Entandikwa
s1.description: Okuramukya, abantu, ebyokurya, enamba, obunaku, ebifo, ka n'amagara marungi.

s2.title: Amagara ga buri izooba
s2.description: Kushoboorora ebintu, kujwara, kugamba aha izooba ryawe, obwire, enyamaishwa, emirimo, eishomero n'orugyendo.

s3.title: Okugamba n'abandi
s3.description: Kwanga, kubuuza, kugamba aha bya ira n'ebirikwija, ebitekateeko, emyezo, esimu n'okuteeka.

s4.title: Ekitundu n'obuhangwa
s4.description: Enganda n'emiziro, obukama, oburimi, ebigyenda, ebyemiziki, okwikiriza, obusubuuzi n'ebihangirwe.

s5.title: Omugambi omukugu
s5.description: Kugyerereranya, kutekateeka, kugamba engano, enfumu, amakuru, obuzibu n'ekitiinwa.

u1.title: Okuramukya
u1.description: Ramukya, weemanyise kandi obare kuhitsya ahari ikumi.

u2.title: Abantu n'ebintu
u2.description: Eka, ebintu bya buri izooba n'ebikorwa byawe by'okubanza.

u3.title: Ebyokurya n'akatare
u3.description: Byeta ebyokurya, gamba ngu oine enjara kandi ogure omu katare.

u4.title: Enamba n'esente
u4.description: Bara kuhitsya ahari enkumi kandi oshashure na shiringi.

u5.title: Obunaku n'eshaaha
u5.description: Gamba aha izooba rya hati, ebiro by'esande n'eshaaha.

u6.title: Ebifo n'emihanda
u6.description: Byeta ebifo omu tauni, gamba ahu orikuza kandi oyoreke omuhanda.

u7.title: Omuka
u7.description: Ebisiika n'ebintu by'omuka, kwakira abagyenyi n'okushaba ebintu.

u8.title: Amagara n'omubiri
u8.description: Byeta ebicweka by'omubiri, gamba ekirikukubabaza kandi oreebe omushaho.

u9.title: Erangi n'okushoboorora
u9.description: Byeta erangi kandi oshoboorore ebintu n'abantu.

u10.title: Emyenda
u10.description: Byeta emyenda yaawe, jwara kandi ogure ekihyaka.

u11.title: Eizooba ryangye
u11.description: Gamba aha bi orikukora kuruga nyenkyakare kuhitsya ekiro.

u12.title: Obwire n'ebiro
u12.description: Gamba aha izooba n'enjura, ebiro by'omwaka n'okuhurira ekyerereezi nari obutiti.

u13.title: Enyamaishwa
u13.description: Enyamaishwa z'omuka, ez'omu ishwa, ez'okureeba n'ensheeshe ya Uganda.

u14.title: Emirimo
u14.description: Gamba ebi orikukora, buuza aha mirimo kandi ogambe aha mushaara.

u15.title: Eishomero
u15.description: Ekyeyo ky'okwegyeramu, ebi orikwega, ebibuuzo n'omukoro gw'omuka.

u16.title: Orugyendo n'entambura
u16.description: Tega takisi nari baasi kandi otegyeke orugyendo omu Uganda.

u17.title: Okwanga
u17.description: Gamba ebi otarikwenda, ebi otaine n'ebi otamanyire.

u18.title: Okubuuza
u18.description: Buuza ani, ki, nkahi, ryari, ahabw'enki, kandi obuuze aha bigambo.

u19.title: Ebi nakozire
u19.description: Gamba ebi wakora erizooba, nyomwabazyo n'ira.

u20.title: Entegyeka
u20.description: Gamba aha nyenkya, aha wiikendi n'ebi orikurooto.

u21.title: Ebitekateeko
u21.description: Gamba oku orikuhurira kandi ofeho abandi.

u22.title: Emyezo n'emizaano
u22.description: Gamba aha bwire bw'okuruhuka, omupiira, ebyemiziki n'emizaano.

u23.title: Aha simu
u23.description: Teera esimu, shindika obutumwa kandi otegyeke okubugana.

u24.title: Okuteeka
u24.description: Kuratira enteekateeka y'okuteeka, cumba ebitookye omu byanda kandi ogabane ekyokurya.

u25.title: Enganda n'emiziro
u25.description: Yega aha nganda, emiziro yazo n'okugamba ou ori.

u26.title: Obukama
u26.description: Kabaka, gavumenti ye n'ebifo by'eby'ira omu Buganda.

u27.title: Ekyaro n'oburimi
u27.description: Kora omu musiri, byeta ebihingwa kandi osharure.

u28.title: Ebigyenda
u28.description: Okwanjura, obugyenyi, amazaarwa n'okugyendera abantu gye.

u29.title: Ebyemiziki n'emizina
u29.description: Engoma, ebyeshongoro n'emizina, n'okushoboorora abantu ahabw'ebi barikukora.

u30.title: Okwikiriza n'ebiro bikuru
u30.description: Ebifo by'okusabiramu, Noeri, Idi, Eizooba ry'Abajurizi n'emigisha.

u31.title: Obusubuuzi
u31.description: Kora edduuka nkye, heereza abaguzi, biika esente kandi oyegyese abandi.

u32.title: Ebihangirwe
u32.description: Enyanja, emigyera, ebishaka n'ebiriima, n'okureeberera ensi.

u33.title: Okugyerereranya
u33.description: Gamba ekiri kihango kukira, ekirungi kukira, ekishushana nari ekitashushana.

u34.title: Obu n'Ku
u34.description: Gamba aha birikubaho obu, ebyakubaire ku, n'ebi waakubaire noyenda.

u35.title: Okugamba engano
u35.description: Tandika engano, egyendeze na “mbwenu” kandi ogihendeke.

u36.title: Enfumu
u36.description: Yega enfumu ezimanyirwe, amakuru gaazo n'obu orikuzikozesa.

u37.title: Amakuru n'ekitundu
u37.description: Kuratira amakuru, gamba omu rukiiko kandi oheeyo ekitekateeko kyawe.

u38.title: Obuzibu bw'amaani
u38.description: Yeta obuhwezi, kora aha kabi kandi orapote obushuma.

u39.title: Ekitiinwa n'emicwe
u39.description: Ramukya abakuru n'ekitiinwa kandi obe omugyenyi murungi.

u40.title: Engano z'ira
u40.description: Bugana Wakayima akakwaavu na Kintu, kandi ogambe eki engano erikwegyesa.
